name: @poketistix/damage-calc
description: Pokémon damage calculator — powered by Rust/WebAssembly

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --scope poketistix --target bundler --out-dir pkg --out-name damage_calc && wasm-pack build --scope poketistix --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node --out-name damage_calc
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run pack && pnpm run pkg:publish
